g.text: M3c sequential auto reservation, StopAuto and CancelRun
reserve AutoId and first RunId under shared lock
start loop with first run handle
[optional caller requests while run is active]
prohibit next admission / leave current run intact
count completion / retain last run only
Manual Start / another StartAuto still returns Busy with BusyAutoId.
prohibit next admission / cancel schedule delay only
[delay succeeded and no stop won the admission lock]
admit next RunId under shared lock
[stop requested, run limit reached or run failed]
finish repetition / preserve last run diagnostics
finish schedule cancellation delivery / dispose schedule token
release auto reservation / save final snapshot
StopAuto and next admission share the engine lock.
If admission wins, StopAuto leaves that run intact.
Engine disposal stops scheduling AND requests current Shutdown,
then waits for both run and session cleanup.
